# Flower

> A private, open-source ASCII image studio by Philipp Paulik.

- [Website](https://flower.philipp-paulik.de/)
- [Browser studio](https://flower.philipp-paulik.de/studio.html)
- [Source](https://github.com/philppplik/flower)
- [Installation](https://github.com/philppplik/flower/blob/main/docs/INSTALLATION.md)

Manual editing and exports stay on the device. Optional AI selection requires the local edition. Exports: PNG, JPEG, WebP, SVG and TXT. MIT license. Still images only.
